title: 12x18 Fantasy Football Loser Garden Flag - Last Place Punishment Gag
description:
Product overview
Bold, funny garden flag made as an unmistakable last‑place label in a warning-style treatment for fantasy football leagues. Perfect for draft parties, end-of-season toilet-bowl ceremonies, watch parties, or as a gag gift that makes the loser display their accomplishment with good-natured humiliation.

Printed text (do not alter)
Eyebrow: OFFICIAL LEAGUE RESULT
FANTASY FOOTBALL
LOSER
Footer: LAST PLACE AND PROUD

Verified product facts
- Size: 12 x 18 inches
- Same design is printed on both sides (double-sided print)
- Weather-resistant polyester
- Top pole sleeve for standard garden-flag stands
- Printed to order
- Garden-flag stand is not included

Production & listing disclosure
This listing and layout were created with AI-assisted layout and listing copy. The flag is produced in partnership with a vetted print-on-demand production partner.

Why buyers choose this flag
- Loud, playful “loser” treatment that reads like an official notice for maximum league embarrassment
- Sized to display at a draft party, watch party, office desk, or yard
- Printed to order so each flag is freshly produced for your league’s moment

Occasions & uses
Draft day props, toilet-bowl penalties, end-of-season ceremonies, league parties, gag gifts. Designed to be worn proudly (or painfully) by the last-place manager.

Note
No stand included. Colors and printing may vary slightly due to on-demand production and monitor differences.
